name: workshop
description: One side pane listing everything you can use in Claude Code (slash commands, skills, mods, hooks, workflows) with what you use most at the top, plus your ideas and drafts.

workshopDir.title: Workshop folder
workshopDir.description: The folder the pane lists (mods/, skills/, hooks/, workflows/, IDEAS.md). Empty: CLAUDE_WORKSHOP_DIR, else ~/claude-workshop, created on first use.

launcher.title: Launcher icon
launcher.description: on: a ⚒ above the prompt opens the workshop. off: open it with /ws.

openAtStart.title: Open at start
openAtStart.description: on: the workshop opens when a session starts. off: it stays closed until you run /ws.
